versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Payload encryption («Довірені пристрої → ШИФРУВАННЯ ДАНИХ»).** The car publishes its data in one of three modes:
  `Вимкнено` (default, plain as before), `Перехідний` (plain and `byd/<vehicle>/enc/<suffix>` side by side) or `Лише зашифровано`
  (only `enc/*`; availability and commands stay plain, plain retained topics are emptied). The content key is delivered only
  in answer to a scan of the car's QR (`bydkey:1?…`) at pairing and at each key change; «Оновити ключ» and a schedule
  (never / yearly / 6 / 3 / monthly, 7-day reminder) restart the countdown. A revoke also changes the key. Phones show the
  key status on «Підключення», banners on Головна and the key link in the scanner and the text field; the HA card holds no key.
  Key files are sealed under the non-exportable `byd_enc_store` Keystore key and excluded from backup; without a working store
  the car fails closed. Commands sealed with the key are answered as before; a plaintext command under `encrypted` gets
  `rejected: not encrypted`. Home Assistant stays on `off` or `both` until its integration decrypts. Spec:
  `openspec/changes/mqtt-payload-encryption/` (car and real-iPhone checks still open).
- **Commands from the phones and the Mac are signed by paired devices.** «Налаштування → Довірені пристрої → Додати пристрій»
  shows a one-time QR code (valid 5 min) with the connection settings and the car's key; the companion app scans it
  (or the Home Assistant integration takes the text), and `scripts/car-cmd.sh pair` pairs the Mac. The car keeps an
  allowlist with revoke and rename, and a mode `off | log | enforce` (default `off`) switched only on the car. Under
  `enforce` an unsigned, unknown, revoked, stale or forged command is refused with a reason on `command/result`.
  The shell `cmd` channel is checked in every mode and `cmd_secret` is gone. Spec: `openspec/changes/mqtt-command-authentication/`.
- **Phones set themselves up from the car's QR.** The companion apps have no manual broker fields any more: the scanned
  link (or pasted text) sets host, port, TLS, WebSocket path, login, password, prefix, vehicle id and car name. A refused
  or unanswered command shows its reason («Відхилено…», «Авто не відповіло») instead of «Команду надіслано».

### Changed
- **`/developer` improves itself after each shipped run.** A new step 8 runs the `developer-retro` skill: it lists
  what went wrong with the pipeline in that session (skill, Workflow, agents, test gate, e2e environment), the owner
  picks what to fix, and the fixes land in the same PR. A registry counts fixes per problem; the 11th fix becomes an
  OpenSpec change `developer-redesign-<id>` for a separate grilling session instead of another patch.
- **`/developer` fixes from the `mqtt-payload-encryption` run (14, in the retro registry).** The pipeline loads from the
  run's worktree; big args come from a file (`argsPath`); a split change builds part by part (`part`, `acOffset`); an
  owner's scope permission reaches the call that stopped, so a resume no longer replays the stop; a redesign keeps the
  earlier Figma frames; the spec review runs in AC chunks, and an AC with no review or autotest result is asked again
  instead of costing a rework round; touched UI targets run in full in the foreground before the autotester judges;
  the researcher probes the car instead of inferring; restart and finish-by-hand paths are documented.
- **Release jobs have time limits.** Every job in `release.yml` stops after a fixed time (tag 10 min, android 30,
  ios 30, card 20, publish 15) instead of hanging; the v0.10.0 and v0.11.0 releases ran well inside them (android ~11
  min, the rest under 3 min).
- **UI tests fail in seconds on a broken flow.** `scripts/e2e.sh` checks every flow before it builds or boots anything
  (the path exists, its sub-flows exist, `maestro check-syntax`, `bash -n`) and stops with the reason;
  `E2E_PREFLIGHT_ONLY=1` runs only that check. A scripted check that dies under `set -e` now n
